checked_classes: Spec violations — checked acceptance requirements for phase creation postconditions, scoped phase/run completion, stage/lifecycle separation, generated-state mutation guidance, implementation-first testing language, explicit authorization, and backend-progress refusal; the diff or paired diff contains corresponding source changes and recorded verification evidence, with remaining team implementation explicitly out of scope.

Correctness — checked modified production paths in scripts/kbd-new-phase.mjs, scripts/kbd-apply.mjs, lib/kbd/spec-backend.mjs, lib/kbd/stage-gate.mjs, and paired full runtime/helper changes for inverted conditions, missing failure propagation, and synthetic progress fallbacks; no blocking defect found in the shown hunks.

Regressions — checked restored/active KBD state artifacts, Execute dispatch versus completion semantics, and the changed doctor compatibility assertion against the stated preservation behavior; no regression proven from the packet.

Security — checked for committed secrets, private key material, unsafe shell enabling, and service/port additions; private signer data is generated only under ignored .scratch and no tracked secret or new daemon is shown.

Constraint breaches — checked generated-surface handling, local-only validation wording, Node-only mini constraints, no forbidden new shell/python files, generated AGENTS/CLAUDE/routing synchronization, and distribution provenance; no new blocking constraint breach proven from the packet.

Silent failure — checked removal of swallowed OpenSpec progress errors and hook-failure reporting paths; remaining best-effort hook behavior is explicitly specified by acceptance criteria and not silent in the shown code.
